topic: Write tcpdump filters without looking them up.
goal: The learner can write a BPF filter for a host-and-port case.
grill: I want to write tcpdump filters without looking them up.
I will run them on the homelab bridge.
I keep guessing which qualifiers combine.

facts.claim: A BPF filter names a protocol, a direction, a host, and a port.
tcpdump -i any port 443 captures traffic on port 443.
Terms inside one filter are ANDed, so host A and port 443 matches only that pair.
facts.wrong: Terms inside one filter are ORed, so the filter matches either one.
